lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: You got a purse and a name for the house steward without anyone counting the silver. Not bad for an evening of small talk.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: Elend Venture isn't what I expected.

lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: Nobody important ever is, until they matter. Keep that one in your pocket — we may need a Venture who isn't his father before this is over.
